title: Maddock Films’ Pooja Meri Jaan Finally Heads to ZEE5 After Four-Year Delay
excerpt: The Mrunal Thakur and Huma Qureshi-led stalking thriller, produced by Dinesh Vijan’s Maddock Films, was caught in distribution limbo following the JioCinema-Hotstar merger before landing on ZEE5.
body:
Key Takeaways
  • Pooja Meri Jaan will stream on ZEE5 after nearly four years of delays.
  • The film was ready for release since late 2022 but faced distribution issues.
  • Director Navjot Gulati criticized the producers for neglecting the project.
  • ZEE5's global reach allows immediate access for the Indian diaspora.
  • Pooja Meri Jaan, starring Mrunal Thakur and Huma Qureshi, will stream on ZEE5 after remaining unreleased for nearly four years.
  • The Maddock Films thriller completed shooting and post-production by the end of 2022 but was stranded after the JioCinema-Disney+ Hotstar merger derailed its original release plan.
  • Director Navjot Gulati had publicly criticised Maddock Films for the delay, saying it damaged his career and that his late father spent his final months asking when the film would release.
  • ZEE5 operates globally, giving Indian diaspora audiences access to the film from day one.

A Long-Delayed Debut

Pooja Meri Jaan, a Hindi-language thriller starring Mrunal Thakur and Huma Qureshi, is finally set to reach audiences after nearly four years in limbo. ZEE5 has announced the film as part of its upcoming content slate, though an official premiere date has not yet been confirmed, Bollywood Hungama reported.

Directed by Navjot Gulati and produced under Dinesh Vijan’s Maddock Films banner, the film completed principal photography in August 2022. Post-production was finished by the end of that year. Despite being ready for release for over three years, the film never made it to screens — until now.

What Held Up the Film

The delay traces back to a series of distribution setbacks. Pooja Meri Jaan was originally planned as a direct-to-digital release on JioCinema. After the merger of JioCinema with Disney+ Hotstar, the new management informed producers that films commissioned under the earlier Jio arrangement could be sold to other platforms, according to Zoom TV.

Maddock Films reportedly attempted to bundle the film with two other unreleased projects — Rumi Ki Sharafat starring Radhikka Madan and Sarvgunn Sampanna featuring Vaani Kapoor — and sell them as a package to streaming services. Negotiations collapsed over the asking price.

In an interview with Variety India earlier this year, director Gulati publicly criticised Maddock Films and co-producer Amar Kaushik for what he described as indifference toward the project. “They are so focused on blockbuster films now that they overlook the smaller projects they have produced,” he said. Gulati disclosed that his father, who passed away in 2024, spent the final months of his life asking when the film would be released. Kaushik reportedly stopped responding to Gulati’s calls and messages after October 2025.

The prolonged limbo also took a professional toll on Gulati, who said producers became reluctant to work with a director whose debut feature remained unreleased.

Inside the Film

Pooja Meri Jaan explores themes of stalking and cybercrime. Mrunal Thakur plays the titular Pooja, a woman being pursued by an anonymous admirer, while Huma Qureshi plays Sana. The cast also includes Vikram Singh Chauhan as Aniket and Vijay Raaz as Jatin. The script was written by Kanishka Singh Deo and Navjot Gulati, with additional screenplay and dialogue by Niren Bhatt. Vishal Mishra composed the film’s music.

The Stars’ Growing Profiles

Both lead actresses have significantly raised their profiles since the film was shot. Mrunal Thakur cemented her reputation with the Telugu romantic drama Sita Ramam (2022), which became a pan-India hit, and the cricket drama Jersey (2022) opposite Shahid Kapoor. She started in television with Kumkum Bhagya before transitioning to film and has built a strong cross-industry presence spanning Hindi and Telugu cinema.

Huma Qureshi, who broke out with Gangs of Wasseypur (2012), has maintained a prominent career across film and streaming. Her portrayal of a Bihar politician in the SonyLIV series Maharani drew critical acclaim, while projects like Monica, O My Darling on Netflix further expanded her audience. She had previously worked with producer Dinesh Vijan on Badlapur (2015).

Global Access for the Indian Diaspora

The film’s streaming debut on ZEE5 carries particular significance for viewers outside India. ZEE5 operates across multiple international markets and has positioned itself as a primary destination for Hindi-language content for the Indian diaspora. Both Thakur and Qureshi have cultivated international followings — Thakur’s work in Telugu cinema resonates with South Asian audiences worldwide, while Qureshi’s Netflix and streaming projects have found audiences across global markets.

For diaspora viewers who followed the behind-the-scenes saga through social media, the ZEE5 debut resolves a long-standing wait. The platform’s international availability means the film will be accessible from day one, bypassing the territorial release windows that can delay access to Indian theatrical content by weeks or months.
